transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… things at home have been bothering me. My wife says it’s just work, late meetings and little changes in her messages, but it’s been going on about a year. It feels too lined up to be random, like there’s some message in it she isn’t saying directly.
Do you feel like your wife might be trying to communicate something to you indirectly, or perhaps hiding something from you?

Yes… I mean, I can’t prove it. But it feels that way. The late meetings, the little changes in her work messages… she says it’s normal office stuff, but it’s been going on long enough that it doesn’t feel accidental. It feels like there’s something she’s trying to say without saying it.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was very low, or on the contrary, unusually high or energized, lasting for days or longer?
I don’t think so. I mean… I’ve had bad days, sure, but not some big stretch where I was really high or couldn’t function. Nothing like that that I’ve noticed.
Have you ever had thoughts that others around you, like your wife, are acting in a coordinated or harmful way towards you, even if there's no proof?

I wouldn’t say harmful, exactly. But… with my wife, yes, it feels coordinated sometimes. The late meetings and small changes in her work messages — she says it’s just normal office stuff, but over the past year it’s lined up too neatly. Like there’s some private signal there, something she won’t just say.
Do you ever feel that people outside of your wife, like coworkers or friends, are also involved in some kind of hidden communication or plan that affects you?

Not really coworkers or friends, no. It’s mostly… with my wife. The late meetings, the little changes in her work messages — she says it’s just office stuff, but over the past year it’s lined up too neatly. Like there’s some private signal there, something she won’t say directly.
Do you ever feel that events or actions in your daily life, outside of your wife’s behavior, have special meaning or are directed at you in some hidden way?

Not really outside of that. It’s mostly tied to my wife’s meetings and her work messages. I know she says it’s normal office stuff, but… they line up too precisely sometimes. Like there’s some kind of private signal in it.
Have you ever had any other situations, besides your concerns about your wife’s messages and meetings, where you felt like things were being hidden from you or communicated in a secret way?

No… not really other situations. It’s mainly what I mentioned with my wife — the late meetings, the little shifts in her work messages. She says it’s normal, but over the past year it’s felt too lined up to be accidental, like there’s something being communicated that she won’t just say.
Do these feelings about hidden messages only happen with your wife, or have you ever felt this way about anyone else or in any other situation?

Only with my wife, really. I haven’t noticed it with other people. It’s just… her late meetings and those small changes in her work messages. She says it’s normal, but it’s been lining up too neatly for about a year, like there’s something she’s trying to signal without saying it.
Have you ever had any other thoughts that something was being hidden from you or meant something special, even when others didn’t see it that way?

Not really beyond that. It’s… mostly my wife’s late meetings and the small changes in her work messages. She says it’s just office stuff, but for about a year it’s felt too precise to be coincidence, like there’s some private signal in it she won’t say directly.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions that others insist are not true, even though you feel certain they must be?

Yes… I suppose that would be the thing with my wife. She says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but… for about a year now they’ve felt too lined up to be accidental. Like there’s some kind of private signal there, something she’s not saying directly.

Even though your wife has told you that the late meetings and message changes are just normal office matters, do you still feel certain that there’s actually a hidden meaning or signal in them that she’s not telling you about?

Yes. I mean… I know what she says. But it’s been going on so long, and the timing of it all just feels too exact. The late meetings, the little changes in the messages… it feels like there’s something in there she’s not saying outright.
Do you ever have other types of beliefs or suspicions that others say aren’t true, but you still feel sure about, outside of what you’ve said about your wife?

No… not really outside of that. It’s mainly just with my wife’s meetings and those work messages. I know she says it’s normal, but it’s been about a year, and it still feels too… lined up to be nothing. Like there’s something meant in it that she won’t just say.

Even though your wife has repeatedly told you that the late meetings and message changes are just normal office matters, and there’s no clear evidence supporting your belief, do you still feel absolutely certain that there’s a hidden meaning or signal in them that she’s not telling you about?

Yes… I do. I know she keeps saying it’s just work, and maybe to someone else it would look that way. But after a year of the late meetings and those little changes in the messages, it feels too precise to be nothing. Like there’s something there… some private signal she won’t just say directly.

Even though there’s no clear proof and your wife has told you repeatedly that the late meetings and message changes are just normal work matters, do you still feel completely certain that there’s a hidden meaning or signal in them that she’s not telling you about?

Yes… I still feel certain. I know she says it’s just normal office stuff, but the late meetings and those little message changes have lined up too neatly for too long. It feels like there’s some private signal in it… something she won’t say directly.

Even though your wife has repeatedly told you that the late meetings and message changes are just normal office matters, and there’s no outside confirmation that anything is hidden in them, do you still believe there must be a secret meaning that she’s not telling you about?

Yes. I know she says it’s just normal work stuff, but… the meetings and those little changes in the messages have been happening for about a year. They line up too precisely to feel accidental. It feels like there’s some private signal in it that she’s not telling me directly.
